description: Camp Bow Wow is a pet care franchise founded in 2003 (as Camp Bow Wow Branding, LLC) and headquartered in Westminster, Colorado, offering dog day care, boarding, grooming, and training through fixed camp locations, plus retail sales of pet food and merchandise. The franchisor, Camp Bow Wow Franchising, Inc., a Delaware corporation, began franchising in August 2014 and is affiliated with Propelled Brands Franchising, LLC. Per the 2025 FDD, the franchise fee is $50,000, total initial investment ranges from $943,606 to $1,199,536, royalties are 3.5% of net revenue in year one and 7% thereafter (or a minimum monthly royalty up to $2,500), and territories are non-exclusive Authorized Territories. Item 19 reports 2024 gross sales from $381,269 to $1,977,249 across 148 reporting locations (66.7% of the 222-location US franchised system). The system totaled 224 outlets at the end of 2024, up from 207 at the end of 2022.
yearFoundedNote: Brand predecessor began operating as Camp Bow Wow Branding, LLC in 2003 (FDD Item 1, p.10); franchisor formed 2014, franchising since August 2014
territoryDescription: Non-exclusive Authorized Territory defined by demographics (population density, income), natural boundaries, and urban/suburban/rural mix. Franchisor reserves extensive rights: non-traditional locations (stadiums, hotels, airports, etc.), internet/digital marketing, wholesale/catalog channels, and mergers/acquisitions — inside or outside your territory. Franchisor may adjust, redefine, or reduce your territory at renewal, and may impose mandatory marketing/training or terminate if 4 of 12 months' revenue fails to clear the minimum monthly royalty.
